assessor: RTS implementation preflight — Exhausted-AI Human Escalation Gate v1
rationale: Repository-local postprocessing of K0 triage plus explicit bounded verification evidence. K1 does not call providers, execute probes, mutate profiles, decide semantic truth, or delete evidence. It maintains a cumulative knowledge state from DA, Counter-DA and completed verification evidence, checks whether that knowledge still permits a defensible decision, further evidence acquisition, a discriminating experiment, or bounded safe defer, and only then decides whether an explicitly exhausted material dead-end may be returned to a human.
affected_boundaries: cumulative knowledge-state and explicit verification/exhaustion evidence records
auditable human handoff packet for exhausted material dead-ends
focused destructive DA and full A-K1 regression
existing_assumptions: K0 preserves exact unresolved anchors, materiality dimensions, adversarial views and problem-solving paths.
K0 and upstream layers grant no execution/profile/promotion authority.
Missing verification evidence is not proof that verification is exhausted.
A failed or refuting verification result is still knowledge and must be folded into the next residual-UNKNOWN assessment.

data_migration.notes: No K0/J/I/H/F/G or prior FREEZER history is mutated in place.

external_interfaces: deterministic advisory escalation report and optional human handoff packet
approval_changes: none; HUMAN_NOW is an advisory human-attention disposition only
regression_tests: knowledge-integration tests proving new evidence changes or narrows residual UNKNOWN before exhaustion
equivalent-probe loop tests preventing attempt-count exhaustion
hidden_dependencies: every completed DA, Counter-DA and verification observation relevant to the finding must be represented in the cumulative knowledge state before escalation classification
a remaining K0 problem-solving path means AI work remains unless bounded verification explicitly exhausted that path
a failed probe can close one hypothesis while opening a different discriminating route and therefore cannot by itself authorize human escalation
repeating an equivalent probe without a changed evidence distinction does not count as progress or exhaustion
uncertainty or disagreement alone cannot prove exhaustion
a discriminating experiment must name a concrete next test or evidence distinction
an evidence-acquisition route must identify what missing evidence would change the decision
a safe defer must name a bounded recheck/trigger condition
HUMAN_NOW requires material effect, explicit exhaustion evidence and a no-new-discriminating-route fixed point
HUMAN_NOW must carry a handoff packet describing tested routes, learned evidence, residual ambiguity, why no AI-side next route remains, and the material human choice
rollback_boundary: Drop the K1 branch or revert human_escalation_gate files and FRZ-000022 append-only versions; completed K0 and A-J remain untouched.
completion_conditions: high-impact K0 items with an unexhausted discriminating probe are not HUMAN_NOW
new DA/Counter-DA/probe evidence is folded into cumulative knowledge and residual UNKNOWN before the next escalation decision
equivalent repeated probes cannot manufacture an exhausted state
items with a concrete evidence-acquisition route are not HUMAN_NOW
items with a bounded safe defer condition are not HUMAN_NOW
missing verification evidence cannot emit HUMAN_NOW
explicitly exhausted material dead-end with no defensible decision, evidence route, experiment or defer emits HUMAN_NOW
HUMAN_NOW includes an auditable exhaustion handoff packet
non-material exhausted dead-end does not emit HUMAN_NOW
live I→J→K0→K1 revalidation reports the current 76-item surface without silently dropping records
A-K1 regressions and FREEZER verify pass
risks: K1 v1 validates exhaustion evidence structurally and cannot infer hidden provider behavior.
A future model-assisted verification proposer must remain behind bounded evidence validation.
A system can still overfit to its own generated probes unless probe equivalence and evidence novelty are checked.
lower HUMAN_NOW count is not itself correctness evidence.
